mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.25% or greater increase in the federal funds rate within three months compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months during a tightening cycle, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals strong residential construction, boosting consumer confidence and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment and declining unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index exceeding 0.3% signals rising inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
